plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): (1) the official EMU catalog program page 'Program: Biology [BS]' (Major Requirements 70 hours; Required Core Courses 25 hours) for core course codes, titles and credits; (2) the official EMU catalog 'Program: Biology [BS] - MiTransfer Pathway' page for the General Biology concentration structure (45 hours: 13-14 required + 31-32 electives) and documented elective course options; (3) the official EMU General Education worksheet (FA22) for gen-ed structure. catalog.emich.edu presents an AWS WAF challenge to automated fetching, so catalog content was verified through the search index of the official catalog pages; every code, title and credit below comes from those official sources. Concentration electives selected: Biology (19 hrs) - BIO 443 Developmental Biology, BIO 330 Neuroanatomy, BIO 476 Mammalian Histology, BIO 474 Comparative Anatomy of Vertebrates, BIO 444 Cell Culture Techniques and Methods; Cognate (13 hrs) - CHEM 351 Foundations of Biochemistry, CHEM 451 Biochemistry I, CHEM 452 Biochemistry II, COSC 111 Introduction to Programming. STAT 170 fills the MATH 120/STAT 170 required slot and GEQR; BIO 306W fills the lab slot and the [GEWI] requirement in the major. This major does not require a minor. PREREQUISITES ARE NOT ENCODED: catalog course pages are WAF-blocked and prereqs are never invented - courses are sequenced in standard biology order; confirm with the catalog and a Biology faculty advisor (annual advising strongly encouraged by the department). 70 major + 30 gen-ed = 100 specified; free-elective choice slots (20 cr) reach the 120-credit minimum.
